text:
Maya: Found a fortune cookie on the kitchen counter that says "Today you'll discover free espresso." Also the espresso carafe is empty. Who's the bandit? :eyes:
Dan: guilty but only took a single shot, promise. left notes? :pleading_face:
Priya: not me. conspiracy: it's the office gnome. :gnome:
Omar: I refilled it this morning at 9:30, left a sticky note. Did somebody unplug the machine?
Jenny: I saw someone with a dark hoodie and a mug with a sticker that said 'Try Me' — maybe hoodie theft. :detective:
Maya: hoodie thief + fortune cookie prophecy. can we do a tiny poll? emoji vote: :coffee: = refill now, :cookie: = save for meeting tomorrow
Dan: :coffee:
Priya: :coffee:
Omar: :cookie: (saving for team sync?)
BrewBot: Auto-reminder: Espresso machine maintenance scheduled today at 15:15. Please avoid leaving grounds in the sink. :robot_face:
Maya: ok quick meetup at the kitchen in 2 to decide fate. snacks provided (one fortune cookie per person) :cookie:
Dan: bringing napkins and a mysterious playlist. :musical_note:
Jenny: hoodie thief, return the hoodie or we start a sticker-justice campaign. :stuck_out_tongue:
Priya: if hoodie returned, we place sticker on it that says 'I surrendered coffee' :laughing:
Omar: vote tally: 2 coffee, 1 cookie. decision: refill now. I'll top it off in 5.
Maya: thank you! crisis averted. fortune cookie line: 'You will be recognized for an unusual kindness.' nice. :sparkles:
Dan: unusual kindness = refilling espresso? i'll accept the accolade. :trophy:
Jenny: kudos to Omar. :clap: also free cookies for the kitchen meetup
Maya: meetup now. also, who wants to name the office gnome? suggestions welcome.
Priya: 'Sir Steals-a-Lot' :laughing:
Omar: 'Espresso Bandito' :coffee:
Maya: voting on names can be a separate thread. end scene. :wave:
